newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka National up 1.7 pct on results.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka National up 1.7 pct on results.

text.p: Shares of National Development Bank Ltd rose 1.7 percent or five rupees to 295 in early Monday trade, brokers said.
"The share price rose on recently released interim results, which showed net profits for the six months to June 30, have gone up 21 percent to 387.77 million rupees," said a broker.
The bank said last week it will convert and float on the Colombo bourse 27.5 million 10-rupee convertible debentures, now held by the government of Sri Lanka.
Under the terms of an early conversion agreement, the debentures will be converted into 18.33 million shares, the bank said.
